hypothesis: A deterministic reciprocal-rank fusion of the frozen global freq_100 Top20 and positional position_seed_mix_top20_v1 Top20 may improve prospective Top20 hit count without retuning either parent engine.

algorithm.candidate_universe: union of the two parent Top20 sets
algorithm.score: S(n) = 1/(20 + rank_global(n)) + 1/(20 + rank_positional(n)); a missing rank contributes 0
algorithm.selection: sort by descending S(n), then ascending numeric value; take first 20

historical_exploratory_audit.reason: These outcomes have already been inspected in H97-H100; all H101 results on these rows are exploratory and excluded from prospective confirmation.

prospective_confirmation.first_target_eligibility: Only if a new H101 row is frozen after this preregistration and before the nominal target draw; existing parent freezes are not edited.
prospective_confirmation.interim_look: No inferential interim looks and no retuning; final analysis only after all 200 outcomes are complete.
prospective_confirmation.primary_endpoint: paired mean Top20 hits: H101 RRF minus freq_100
prospective_confirmation.primary_test: two-sided exact paired sign-flip randomization; a positive estimate and adjusted p < 0.05 are required for superiority
secondary_endpoints: paired mean Top20 hits: H101 RRF minus position_seed_mix_top20_v1
absolute H101 Top20 hit count versus exact iid-uniform Hypergeometric(40,20,5) convolution
prospective_confirmation.multiple_testing: Holm step-down across the three registered H101 Top20 endpoints
prospective_confirmation.uncertainty: circular moving-block bootstrap, block length 20, 10000 replicates, fixed seed 1012026
prospective_confirmation.q60_primary_gate: The existing global-vs-positional Q60 gate remains separate and unchanged; no promotion until its 200-pair gate and human review pass.

leakage_and_integrity_guards: The H101 forecast may use only the two parent lists frozen from data through the previous canonical draw.
Fusion freeze timestamp must be later than both parent freeze timestamps and earlier than 19:00 Europe/Rome on the target date.
Target outcome fields are never read by the freeze-generation script.
The canonical archive must end exactly at the declared history_cutoff.
No missing freeze is reconstructed and no existing forecast row is modified.
All outputs are append-only and research-only.
